newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks expected to open lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks expected to open lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open lower on Wednesday after the previous day's high-tech sell-off, analysts said.

They said that the Dow's performance will depend to some extent on DuPont Co's third quarter net profits, the behaviour of IBM shares and what effect the reported settlement of a strike with the Canadian Auto Workers Union will have on shares of General Motors Corp.
"General Motors is a Dow component and it will help the average to the extent that it moves higher on the news," said Hildergard Zagorski, analyst at Prudential Securities.

"But a lot also depends on the DuPont earnings and what IBM does after the sell-off we had in high techs yesterday. On the whole, I think this market has run out of steam and is on the defensive. Still, I wouldn't rule out some firming this afternoon after a weak opening."
